premise: One record per gene, joined across every artefact on disk. The absences are values: a gene measured in the screen and found in no cancer subgroup is a different statement from a gene that was never measured, and each layer publishes the scope it could have spoken about.
worldPremise: What the public catalogues already hold about each gene, read per gene rather than in aggregate. The ClinVar VUS share is included as a measurement of attention, not of the gene: a gene whose variants nobody could interpret is a gene nobody had the cohort or the assay for.
